title: Separating algorithmic change from language change in a Rust rewrite of a real time threat scorer
description: Code and aggregated results of the study "Separating algorithmic change from language change in a Rust rewrite of a real time threat scorer", a follow on study of the SentinelSphere platform carried out under the Horizon Europe project ResilMesh, Grant Agreement No. 101119681. The repository holds the analysis code, the result tables and the figures of the Open Research Europe article. Third party datasets and benchmark items are not included.
